aracne.description: A spider-like creature with a venomous bite. Known for its speed and agility in combat.

banshee.description: A wailing spirit that haunts the living. Her scream can paralyze even the bravest warriors.

cerberos.description: A three-headed dog guarding the gates of the underworld. Fierce and loyal to its master.

dragon.description: A fearsome and ancient creature. Known for its immense power and destructive breath.

fenrir.description: A giant wolf prophesied to bring the end of the world. Fearsome and unpredictable in battle.

ghoul.description: A creature that feasts on the flesh of the dead. Often found in graveyards or abandoned crypts.

jupia.description: A mysterious aquatic creature with the ability to summon storms. Dangerous near bodies of water.

kelpie.description: A water spirit that lures travelers to watery graves. Known for its shape-shifting abilities.

lugaru.description: A fearsome wolf-like beast. Highly territorial and vicious in battle.

mokelembembe.description: A massive, dinosaur-like creature from the Congo basin. It is said to be both elusive and dangerous.

nefelin.description: A mysterious feline creature that moves with the shadows. Its agility makes it difficult to catch.

titan.description: A massive and powerful entity. Few can survive a battle with a Titan due to its overwhelming strength.

yinn.description: A mystical being with powers over the forces of nature. It can control winds, storms, and natural elements.
